clue.text: Smitten gay men date heartless Trojan hunk

indicators.note: smitten can mean struck hard, so the words that follow are knocked into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, for rearranging

indicators.note: without a heart, the word loses its central letters

parts.note: taken as written, before its middle goes

explanation.surface: A lovestruck crowd of gay men dating a handsome Trojan.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing the middle two letters of DATE leaves DE. Ganymede was the beautiful Trojan youth carried off by Zeus.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Ganymede, a Trojan prince, was so handsome that Zeus abducted him to be cupbearer of the gods.

clue.text: Deer raised by mysterious millionaire

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means lifted upward, so the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a stag is a male deer
taken as written

explanation.surface: A deer is reared by an enigmatic rich man.
explanation.definitionFit: Jay Gatsby is the enigmatic wealthy title character of F. Scott Fitzgerald's novel The Great Gatsby.

clue.text: Fair comment?

parts.note: surface reading: a remark that is just and reasonable, as in the legal defence
setter's reading: what a person says to call something only fair, middling

explanation.walkthrough: Fair comment sounds like a legal phrase; here fair means passable, and the answer is a remark you would make about something passable.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something is reasonably good but unremarkable is calling it fair, a verdict expressed by this phrase.

clue.text: Staff gathered round the Italian financial centre

indicators.note: gathered round means encircling, so one piece goes around another

parts.note: to staff a post is to man it
il is Italian for the

explanation.surface: Employees cluster round an Italian at a banking hub.
explanation.definitionFit: Milan is Italy's main business city and home of its stock exchange.

clue.text: Lower in rank, Democrat agreed changes

indicators.note: changes signals that the letters before it are altered into another arrangement

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for Democrat
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A Democrat's agreement alters, and they are demoted.
explanation.definitionFit: To degrade an officer is to reduce their status, a demotion.

clue.text: Lucky animal in mum's bed

parts.note: Ma is mum, with the possessive kept
a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A lucky pet curled up in mother's bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a creature or figure kept by a team as a bringer of good luck.

clue.text: Right to enter guilty plea?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: permission to go in
second meaning: a confession of wrongdoing

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a guilty plea is one example of owning up.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both being allowed entry and acknowledging a fault, as when confessing.

clue.text: See 26
Con man and two Lawrences dine on hearts

parts.note: the initials of T. E. Lawrence and D. H. Lawrence
to dine is to eat
H is the card-game abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: A swindler and two famous writers eat heart for dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: Con is short for Conservative: Edward Heath was a Conservative British Prime Minister, known as Ted.
explanation.definitionFit: Ted Heath was a Conservative politician, so literally a Tory man.

clue.text: On time, with time, league organised training

indicators.note: something organised has been arranged afresh, so these letters are put into a new order

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
a second T for time
taken as written

explanation.surface: A punctual sports league arranges its coaching sessions on schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutelage is instruction or guidance given by a tutor, which is a form of training.

clue.text: Made to smile with a thought

parts.note: taken as written
mused means pondered or thought

explanation.surface: Someone smiles at an idea that has occurred to them.
explanation.definitionFit: To be amused is to be entertained, the state that makes a person smile.

clue.text: French feline in casual conversation

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the French word for cat

explanation.surface: A cat from France has a friendly natter.
explanation.definitionFit: Chat is French for cat, and in English it means relaxed talk.

clue.text: British artist at home was hard to indoctrinate

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for British
RA, Royal Academician, is the usual crossword artist
someone at home is in
taken as written
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A British painter found it difficult to impose beliefs on people.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean to force a set of beliefs on someone by persistent pressure.

clue.text: Jumblies' craft is returned the night before

indicators.note: something returned goes back the way it came, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written, to be turned round
an eve is the evening before an event

explanation.surface: A nonsense-poem boat comes back on the evening before something.
explanation.walkthrough: In Edward Lear's poem The Jumblies, the Jumblies went to sea in a sieve.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary-allusion definition: the vessel the Jumblies sailed in was a sieve, a mesh utensil.

clue.text: Looker's sore in Vogue, not ultimately cool

indicators.note: not means without, so the named letter is taken away

parts.note: vogue means fashion or style

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the following word

parts.note: the final letter of cool

explanation.surface: A fashion model's eye infection is not at all cool in a magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid, a sore that afflicts someone who looks.

clue.text: Crashing bore corrupted live data wife enters

indicators.note: enters means goes inside, so one piece is put within another
corrupted data is scrambled, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, for rearranging
W is the abbreviation for wife

explanation.surface: A tedious person's computer crashes after his wife corrupts his files.
explanation.walkthrough: A bore is a surge wave travelling up a river; crashing is part of the definition, not an anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A bore is a tidal surge, and a crashing one is a huge destructive sea wave.

clue.text: Short step allowed in three rhyming lines

parts.note: a trip is a quick, light step
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A dance move is permitted in a verse with three rhymed lines.
explanation.definitionFit: In prosody a triplet is a group of three consecutive lines sharing one rhyme.

clue.text: Singer last to apply choke in Russian car

indicators.note: in places the preceding pieces inside the next one

parts.note: Lada is a Russian make of car

indicators.note: last to points to the final letter of the next word

parts.note: the final letter of apply
to gag is to choke

explanation.surface: A singer uses the choke to start her old Russian car.
explanation.definitionFit: Lady Gaga is a famous American pop singer.

clue.text: Musical comedy avoids publisher

parts.note: to duck is to avoid
OUP is Oxford University Press

explanation.surface: A stage musical evades the firm that would publish it.
explanation.definitionFit: Duck Soup is a 1933 Marx Brothers film comedy with songs.

clue.text: Like French and German articles in pieces

parts.note: as means like
un is a French indefinite article
der is a German definite article

explanation.surface: French and German articles are compared to something torn apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Asunder is an old-fashioned adverb meaning apart, broken into separate pieces.

clue.text: Rough diamonds in Parisian street

indicators.note: in places the preceding piece inside the following one

parts.note: rue is French for street
D is the card-suit abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: Uncut diamonds turn up on a street in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: Rough diamonds looks like one phrase, but rough is the definition on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: Rude can mean crude or roughly made, as in a rude hut.

clue.text: Person unknown from a Crown Dependency

parts.note: a man is a person
X is the algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: An anonymous person comes from one of Britain's self-governing islands.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man is a Crown Dependency, a self-governing island under the British Crown but not part of the UK.
explanation.definitionFit: Manx is the adjective for things belonging to the Isle of Man.

clue.text: Fog with beginnings of rain and light wind

parts.note: mist is a light fog

indicators.note: beginnings are opening letters, so the first of each following word is taken

parts.note: the first letters of these three words

explanation.surface: Foggy weather with a little rain and a gentle breeze.
explanation.walkthrough: Light seems to describe the wind, but its first letter is part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The mistral is a strong cold northerly wind that blows down the Rhône valley into southern France.

clue.text: Region in terrain so bare up country

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means read from the bottom upward
a region in something is an area lying inside it, so the letters sit within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters running across these words

explanation.surface: A district of barren land high in the hills of some country.
explanation.walkthrough: Region looks like the definition, but it belongs with in to point inside the words that follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Bosnia is used as the short name of the Balkan nation Bosnia and Herzegovina.

clue.text: Person consulting doctor not one generally accessible

indicators.note: not means without, so the named letter is removed

parts.note: a patient sees a doctor
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A patient is told the doctor cannot be reached by everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Patent in its older sense means open to the public, and a patent document was openly available.

clue.text: Couple with pound for peasant

parts.note: to yoke is to couple together
L is the abbreviation for a pound

explanation.surface: A pair of coins is offered to a poor farmhand.
explanation.definitionFit: A yokel is an unsophisticated country person, much like a peasant.

clue.text: General's wife some French fiend initially assailed

parts.note: des is French for some
a demon is a fiend

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the word beside it

parts.note: the opening letter of assailed

explanation.surface: A military man's wife is attacked by a French devil.
explanation.walkthrough: The general is Othello, the Moorish general in Shakespeare's play, who murders his wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Desdemona is Othello's wife, and Othello is a general in the Venetian army.

clue.text: Cellist loves silly old singer-songwriter

indicators.note: silly means foolish and muddled, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written, for rearranging
O is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: A cellist adores a foolish ageing songwriter.
explanation.walkthrough: Old here supplies its abbreviation and joins the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Elvis Costello is an English musician known for writing and performing his own songs.

clue.text: Mrs Batty going into Marks periodically for garment

indicators.note: going into means entering, so one piece is placed inside another
periodically means at regular intervals, so every other letter is kept

parts.note: the second and fourth letters of Marks
Nora Batty is a character in the TV sitcom Last of the Summer Wine

explanation.surface: A sitcom housewife visits Marks & Spencer to buy clothing.
explanation.walkthrough: Nora Batty, famed for wrinkled stockings, is from the long-running British sitcom Last of the Summer Wine; Marks is Marks & Spencer, a British high-street store.
explanation.definitionFit: An anorak is a hooded waterproof jacket, an item of clothing.

clue.text: Established church in French region

parts.note: proven means established as true
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: An old established church stands somewhere in southern France.
explanation.definitionFit: Provence is a historic region of south-eastern France.

clue.text: Program from tech giant, leader in tech

parts.note: Apple is a giant technology company

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: the opening letter of tech

explanation.surface: Software from a big tech firm, which leads in technology.
explanation.definitionFit: An applet is a small application, a piece of software that runs inside another program.

clue.text: Students exploit master

parts.note: a class is a group of students
an exploit is a deed or act

explanation.surface: Pupils take advantage of their schoolteacher.
explanation.definitionFit: A class act is someone of outstanding skill, an expert at the top of their field.
